heroHeadline: Panama Canal May Cut Ship Traffic Further as El Niño Strengthens Drought
heroSubtitle: Canal authorities warned on Sept. 8 they may impose further transit reductions as a strengthening El Niño deepens Panama's drought, compounding already-reduced slot allocations and draft limits that have been tightened multiple times since December 2025.
